60190e7 2023-05-12 Add SPDX license tags to source files.
ea027f8 2023-04-22 remove a not needed check switch n == NULL to !n
4970cf9 2023-04-22 mnotes: make sure passed data isnt NULL before loading (#102)
690d4bf 2022-04-24 wrap all macro parameters in() to avoid expansion issues
01800c3 2021-09-21 Fix and avoid more warnings (#76)
e93be91 2021-01-30 limit the amount of tags we allow in the makernote here.
ec412aa 2020-05-16 Ensure the MakerNote data pointers are initialized with NULL.
435e21f 2020-05-16 Fix MakerNote tag size overflow issues at read time.
d0ec90f 2018-06-18 Avoid OOB read on short buffer in various Olympus-like MakerNotes.
a0c04d9 2019-06-15 fixed a buffer overread (OSS-Fuzz) https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=8884
b69ca32 2017-07-26 check for good sizes in the byteorder swap function in the makernote code.
d5a1fb9 2017-05-26 Fixed some type warnings in log messages by explicitly casting to unsigned
8cb3ca0 2017-05-26 Removed some extraneous #define DEBUG
fa38d62 2010-12-01 Reuse exif_mnote_data_olympus_identify_variant() to detect the MakerNote type while actually parsing the tag.
eab595b 2010-10-07 Refactored MakerNote detection code to put detection of each type into the module handling that type
c7f6053 2010-01-29 Commented out some overly-verbose debug messages
63baf46 2009-10-26 Updated the Free Software Foundation's street address
6af9c51 2009-09-25 Jan Patera's keen eyes noticed that my MakerNote unification changes introduced a case where a NULL pointer would be dereferenced before being checked for NULL.
bdd5c7e 2009-09-24 Fixed some problems in MakerNote parsing that could cause a read past the end of a buffer and therefore a segfault. Allow MakerNote parsing to continue even if one tag parses incorrectly. Log an error whenever memory allocation fails in MakerNote parsing.
1277621 2009-03-21 2009-03-21  Lutz Mueller <lutz@users.sourceforge.net>
b69114d 2009-01-13 Uncomment this to fix a problem with Sanyo MakerNotes. It's probably best not to in most cases because it seems to only affect the thumbnail tag which is duplicated in IFD 1, and fixing the offset could actually cause problems with other software that expects the broken form. Also, don't log such detected corruption with EXIF_LOG_CODE_CORRUPT_DATA as the exif front-end currently aborts when it gets such logs. It might be better to change that behaviour of the front-end instead.
48a373c 2009-01-13 Added support for Epson MakerNotes, which have the identical tag format and namespace of the Olympus ones.
83f34a5 2008-12-10 A couple problems with corrupted Olympus-style MakerNote tags are fixed. First, corrupted MakerNote tags are dropped instead of causing the tag to be filled with garbage data. Second, a bug in some Sanyo cameras causes the MNOTE_OLYMPUS_TAG_THUMBNAILIMAGE data offset to be stored as an absolute offset in the file instead of relative to the IFD. An attempt is now made to detect and work around this problem.
16f7cc0 2008-10-04 Heuristic fix of bug #2071600 and gnome Bug #549029: Corrupted Nikon D1H file resaved in II order with original v1 makernote in MM order. Original v1 makernotes are always in MM order. Such makernotes are now always expected to be in MM order (the way we detect this makernote version ensures it really is in the MM order), regardless of the parent exif data order.
edac0f9 2008-10-02 Replaced unsigned int by size_t in some places Added some checks on sizes, makernotes shouldn't be larger than 64kb.
e327492 2008-02-17 2008-02-17  Lutz Mueller <lutz@users.sourceforge.net>
d28ca29 2008-02-16 2008-02-16  Lutz Mueller <lutz@users.sourceforge.net>
8cc41c9 2007-11-10 Added support for Sanyo makernotes, which are identical to Olympus
593956b 2007-08-16 Fix of bugs #1773810, #1774626, gnome bug #466044: Olympus files have main IFD in MM order as well as makernote, but makernote endianness was guessed wrongly. Bug introduced when fixing bug #1525770.
8db9573 2007-06-25 Endianess of Nikon V1 makernotes is now guessed, it might not be the same as of the main IFD.
fa38d62 2010-12-01 14:20:41 -0800 Reuse exif_mnote_data_olympus_identify_variant() to detect the MakerNote type while actually parsing the tag.
